subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed only as per-turn untrusted structured context, through plugin hook metadata, or persisted as session metadata for later Conversions API use?
rationale: The extraction is bounded, but the requested value is an advertising click identifier and the issue explicitly asks for agent/session exposure, so automation should not choose the visibility and retention boundary.

options.title: Per-turn untrusted context
options.body: Extract CTWA fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing untrusted structured-context prompt path without durable persistence.

options.title: Plugin-hook attribution payload
options.body: Define a typed WhatsApp attribution payload for opted-in plugin hooks so a Conversions API plugin can consume it without putting the identifier into every prompt.

options.title: Persist session attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session state only after maintainers define retention, redaction, and access rules.

recommendation.title: Per-turn untrusted context
recommendation.body: Extract CTWA fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing untrusted structured-context prompt path without durable persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is the prompt/plugin/session visibility and retention boundary, and history points to adjacent structured-context and session-metadata work.
